sources.note: Published version of the thesis. Gorovu sec. 2.23.41.2, printed p.87 (village, 50 speakers, closer to Adjora than Banaro); Agoan typological features p.87-88 are morphological only. Printed p.6: same sentence that stress marking is omitted because stress patterning is not established. Silent on Gorovu stress.

sources.citation: Z'graggen, John A. 1969. Classificatory and typological studies in languages of the Madang District, New Guinea. PhD thesis, Australian National University. x+335 pp. http://hdl.handle.net/1885/130077

sources.note: Gorovu (lg 69 'Gv') appears only in sec. 2.23.41.2 (printed p.167: location, 45 speakers, expected to die out) and in Gv rows of pronoun/typological tables (PDF pp.182-186, 319-320). Printed p.13 (PDF p.22), for the whole survey: 'The marking of stress has been omitted, since the stress patterning has not been well established yet.' Nothing on Gorovu stress.
